name: Motorcycle Simulator Utah
summary:
Ride Salt Lake City from the seat - alone, or with your friends.

44 KM OF REAL SALT LAKE CITY
I-15 south through the valley, the I-215 Belt Route under the Wasatch with Mount Olympus beside you, Foothill Drive past Research Park, and 500 South past Rice-Eccles Stadium into downtown, the Wells Fargo Center and the Capitol dome ahead. Real roads, real hills, real mountains.

RIDE ONLINE TOGETHER
Up to four riders in a room. Quick Ride joins an open room; Private Room gives you a 4-digit code for your friends
